description: This file contains a PHP trait 'StreamDecoratorTrait' used in the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 implementation. It defines methods for decorating stream objects, allowing for additional behaviors or modifications of core stream functionality.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the trait with a StreamInterface object to decorate.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to dynamically create or access the 'stream' property.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the stream, seeking to the beginning if possible.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Retrieves the entire contents of the stream as a string.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Delegates method calls to the underlying stream object, returning either the result or the decorator itself.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the underlying stream, returning it.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream, if known.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached end-of-file.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the stream pointer.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the stream pointer to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Moves the stream pointer to a specified position.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Abstract method to create a stream; should be implemented by subclasses.
